coordinate_system.map: meters; x = east, y = north; origin = Century Tower centroid
coordinate_system.map_to_game: X = round((x - center_x) * 100); Z = round(-(y - center_y) * 100); Y = round(height_m * 100)
coordinate_system.note: SM64 is Y-up and +Z points south, hence the minus sign on Z. Windows are axis-aligned (north up).

notes: In the v1.5.1 source, src/engine/surface_load.c allocates surfaces and nodes from GrowingArrays that double on demand, and nothing in that file reads SURFACE_POOL_SIZE. So 16384 works as a performance/design cap, not as a crash limit. Per-cell density (surfaces per 10.24 m cell) is what find_floor/find_wall pay for each player and object every frame.
DynOS COL_VERTEX/COL_TRI args are s16: <= 32767 verts per collision; coords fit +-32767 (window <= 655 m).
Object (non-level) collision models are capped at 4095 vertices.
Environment (water) regions are capped at 20 per area.
GEO_CAMERA_FRUSTUM far plane is s16: max draw distance ~32767 units (327 m). Use fog and keep backdrop shells cheap.

priority: OSM building:levels x floor_height[type] + 1 m parapet (flat roofs)
default levels by type + footprint area (rule below)

default_levels.university/college/school/office/commerc: 1 if area<150 m2, 2 if <1500, 3 if <5000, else 4
default_levels.yes (unknown): 1 if area<400, 2 if <2000, else 3; any building <30 m2 -> 3.0 m
default_levels.roof/pavilion/carport/shelter: canopy slab at 4.0 m, no walls

height_rules.roof: hip for house/detached/residential/church/chapel/barn/shed with <= 8 verts or roof:shape hipped/gabled; otherwise flat. Hip ridge = min(0.25 x short side, 4 m). Collision may use flat roofs everywhere.

simplification_rules.skip: area < 15 m2, or building in construction/no/corridor/ruins/bridge -> not built
simplification_rules.tiny: 15-60 m2 -> minimum-area bounding rectangle (4 verts): 8 wall + 2 roof tris
simplification_rules.large: > 3000 m2 -> Douglas-Peucker 0.75 m, max 24 verts (tolerance x1.4 until it fits); fallback to min-area rectangle if area drops > 40%
simplification_rules.canopy: roof/pavilion/shelter -> roof slab only (max 8 verts), posts visual-only
simplification_rules.building_parts: OSM building:part ways are used only to guide hand-modeled landmarks (the stadium tiers)
simplification_rules.shared_walls: adjacent buildings that share edges: cull the hidden wall of the lower building (both are in OSM as separate ways)
simplification_rules.backdrop: buildings whose centroid lies in the outer backdrop band (stages[].play_margin_m): visual-only shells (<= 8 verts, flat), no collision
simplification_rules.trees: mapped trees are visual low-poly (12 tris); woods are scattered billboards (1 per 80 m2); only gameplay trees become climbable tree objects (0 static tris, use object slots)
simplification_rules.paths_roads: painted into the ground texture / visual ribbons only; no collision. Curbs are not modeled.
simplification_rules.steps: each simplified steps segment -> ramp + 2 cheek walls (4 tris)
simplification_rules.barriers: walls/fences -> double-sided thin wall, 4 tris per simplified segment
simplification_rules.ground: 40.96 m collision patches (4x4 cells, offset half a cell); 10.24 m visual grid for vertex color
simplification_rules.landmarks: hand-modeled in Blender with the per-landmark collision budgets in stages[].landmarks
